verdict.rationale: The IVS Real-Time user guide documents a host-to-viewer latency target of under 300 ms, which is suitable for conversational use. The same guide frames that tier around live-conversation use cases such as guest spots and audio rooms. The community's 2-second figure refers to the separate RTMP-to-HLS low-latency path and does not contradict the real-time claim. Missing for 10: a measured or broken-down latency path (ingest, transport, playout), conditions or percentiles behind the 'can be under 300 ms' wording, and independent hands-on corroboration of real-time latency.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation

citations.quote: Deliver live streams with a latency that can be under 300 milliseconds from host to viewer.
Invite listeners to join the conversation as guests and foster deeper engagement in your audio rooms.
Create applications that allow hosts to promote guests "on stage," turning viewers into hosts for real-time interactions.
